# HIV

**Omaha Guidance:**

RECOMMENDATIONS NOT AVAILABLE
Recommendations for this condition are not available within CDSS. Please refer to facility guidelines or other clinical resources for recommendations.

**Minneapolis Guidance:**

## Inpatient/Outpatient

HIV infection and AIDS are associated with several host defense defects. Cell-mediated immune defects render a patient more susceptible to opportunistic infections with pathogens like Pneumocystis jirovecii (formerly Pneumocystis carinii), Toxoplasma gondii, cytomegalovirus, mycobacterium-avium intracellulare complex, and Candida spp.

Contact ID or HIV service for assistance.
